incidents.vector: Exploited critical unauthenticated PHP remote-code-execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619, "PHP2Shell") using an agentic AI attack platform for post-exploitation.
incidents.impact: Within two hours of initial access, attackers exfiltrated password hashes and MFA secrets, built an NTLM-relay tunnel into Active Directory, and attempted Domain Admin privilege escalation, prompting a precautionary website shutdown.

incidents.victim: 27+ e-commerce retailers, including at least one Fortune 500 company
incidents.vector: A Chinese-speaking attacker used the agentic AI system Hermes with the Strix and Cairn AI penetration-testing frameworks to autonomously scan and exploit 105 e-commerce sites.
incidents.impact: Within hours to a day, 27 companies were compromised; attackers stole at least 600,000 payment card records from two retailers and installed card skimmers on five sites, at an average cost of $25.46 per completed target.

incidents.vector: Theft of personal data from gamer accounts.
incidents.impact: Personal data of more than 11.7 million Capcom gamers was stolen, including usernames, emails and account technical details.
Data on 2.76 million customers of the South Korean coffee and tea chain was stolen.

incidents.vector: Compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup application credentials and used the ARTEX agentic-AI penetration-testing framework to automate OAuth abuse and credential attacks against Microsoft 365 tenants.
incidents.impact: Attackers achieved privileged cloud persistence at multiple organizations within three hours, generating up to 2,900 sign-in attempts per minute against manufacturing, aerospace, chemicals, energy, defense and financial-services targets; ConnectWise suspended its Cloud Backup and related SaaS services.

incidents.victim: eMudhra and downstream organizations relying on its TLS certificates
incidents.vector: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA private keys were generated with insufficient randomness during an April 2025 key ceremony, allowing the keys to be computed from public certificates in under a second.
incidents.impact: Apple, Google, Mozilla and Microsoft revoked or distrusted the affected intermediates and eMudhra exited the SSL/TLS certificate business; no confirmed exploitation or data breach was identified.

incidents.vector: Unauthorized access to the Quanum Lab Services Manager (LSM) customer-facing ordering and results platform.
incidents.impact: Quest believes some patient data was accessed and took the system offline while investigating with law enforcement; no lab testing operations were affected.
Data belonging to almost 4,000 SBI customers was stolen, prompting scrutiny of cybersecurity defenses at Indian banks.

incidents.victim: LiteLLM users (developers, AI gateways, CI/CD environments)
incidents.vector: Attackers compromised a LiteLLM maintainer's GitHub credentials to publish a malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 package to PyPI containing credential-stealing code that executed automatically via Python startup hooks.
incidents.impact: The malware harvested developer, cloud, AI-provider and browser credentials from any environment that started Python with the package installed, even without using LiteLLM directly; stolen data was encrypted and exfiltrated to an attacker-controlled server.

incidents.vector: Cyberattack on municipal IT systems, suspected ransomware.
incidents.impact: The MyColaSC utility-payment platform, GIS systems and animal-services systems were taken offline; police, fire, 911 and water billing remained operational while the state Law Enforcement Division investigates.

incidents.vector: Breach of the Tradeworks internet trading system.
incidents.impact: Attackers accessed data on nearly 5,000 traders and placed unauthorized purchase orders on at least seven accounts, apparently testing their access.

incidents.vector: Breach of VPS infrastructure and malware installation.
incidents.impact: Malware was installed on more than 26,700 Desktop Cloud servers to steal credentials for trading and securities tools; the provider shut down affected servers within a day of discovery.

incidents.victim: 40+ port authorities, maritime and shipping companies (via CyberLogitec)
incidents.vector: Supply chain compromise of South Korean maritime IT provider CyberLogitec, pivoting to customer networks.
incidents.impact: The n0n ransomware and extortion group listed 40+ victims across 18 countries on its leak site, demanding a combined $1.2 billion in ransom; most refused to pay and had data leaked, making it the largest maritime-sector cyberattack since NotPetya.

incidents.victim: Federal Bureau of Investigation (fbijobs.gov recruitment portal)
incidents.vector: ShinyHunters hacked the FBI's recruitment website and stole personnel files.
incidents.impact: Stolen data reportedly included medical and psychological records, Social Security numbers, home addresses and unit/specialization details of FBI personnel; the group threatened to publish the data, prompting an accelerated investigation and multiple arrests of suspects and alleged facilitators.

incidents.victim: 700+ French and European supermarkets (Intermarché/Les Mousquetaires and others)
incidents.vector: Attackers exploited unpatched Danfoss and Dixell/Copeland refrigeration controller vulnerabilities (disclosed in August) to remotely override defrost cycles and raise freezer and fridge temperatures to 50°C.
incidents.impact: Refrigeration and freezer units across France, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Germany, Belgium and the Netherlands were disabled, spoiling food and causing some minor fires; Intermarché alone reported tens of millions of euros in losses.

incidents.vector: An unidentified third party misused Sourcenext's member-information retrieval API.
incidents.impact: 22,519,960 customer records were compromised, including email addresses, passwords, names, addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth and employment information.

incidents.vector: Ransomware attack against Japanese cloud provider IDCFrontier.
incidents.impact: 495 downstream companies and local governments that relied on IDCFrontier's hosting services were disrupted.
